messages:
marta: quick heads-up — running a keystore rotation DRY-RUN in staging at 23:00 UTC. will be toggling the keystore proxy and flipping a few service-account bindings. expect some transient 403s from CI.
kevin: noted. does this affect GHA SAST job that hits keystore for certs? any chance it will fail the scanner and block merges? :eyes:
marta: yes, the SAST job fetches a signing key from keystore via the scanner-sa. plan is to temporarily grant ephemeral decrypt to scanner-sa for the window, then revoke. we should coordinate so SAST doesn't auto-block if it fails once.
li: we need an evidence plan if it does fail — don't want PRs blocked without triage data. can we capture the GHA job logs + keystore audit entries and upload to ticket? I'll set up a short retention snapshot.
toni: +1. also add a bypass policy for the merge-check: if scanner job fails with keystore 403 during the maintenance window, it should set a non-blocking warning instead of fail. change can be done in policy-alpha until this is validated.
marta: exact — I'll open a tiny feature flag: `sast.keystore_maintenance_mode` that flips the gating behavior for this window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1429 (WIP)
sam: what's the rollback plan if something unexpected happens? we should be able to revert bindings within 2 minutes.
marta: rollback: 1) revoke ephemeral rolebindings 2) flip proxy back 3) run quick smoke SAST pipeline on `infra/keystore-test` branch. I'll tag oncall for assistance.
oncall-bot: Incident playbook reminder: if scan failures cascade to >5 PRs or >10 merge requeues within 30m, escalate to @kevin and open incident stub.
kevin: OK. can we also ensure keystore audit logs are ingested into SIEM with the right fields (actor, action, resource, request_id) so security has deterministic evidence? previous rotation had gaps.
li: I'll create a quick Splunk query and a saved dashboard for the window: `index=keystore api:decrypt request_id=* | stats count by actor, action, status` — will snapshot at 23:05.
toni: RBAC note: ephemeral grant should be a `RoleBinding` to `scanner-sa` with TTL via our ephemeral-cred-controller (see infra doc). Do not add long-lived IAM policy.
marta: using ephemeral-cred-controller. snippet I plan to run:
```
kubectl create rolebinding ephemeral-scan-rr --role=scanner-decrypt --serviceaccount=infra:scanner-sa --namespace=keystore --duration=10m
```
This is a dry-run variant that the controller will enforce and auto-expire.
sam: can the SAST runner retry fetch once with backoff instead of immediate fail? small change in runner (2 retries, 5s) avoids flakiness.
kevin: agree. also add token-level observability so we can trace a failed GHA run back to the exact keystore request_id. correlate via `X-Request-ID` header.
li: copying log sample from last rotation where we lost traceability:
```
2025-11-01T23:02:11Z [keystore-proxy] "POST /v1/decrypt" status=403 actor=scanner-sa req_id=abc123 span=
```
We need full req_id in both GHA runner logs and keystore logs.
marta: I'll patch the proxy to echo back req_id to CI and push the PR to infra. Also will create a CHECKLIST in the ticket:
- [ ] set maintenance_flag
- [ ] create ephemeral rolebinding (10m)
- [ ] trigger GHA SAST on test branch
- [ ] snapshot keystore audit logs to /evidence/keystore-rotation-1765439999
- [ ] monitor merge-queue for failed scans
- [ ] revoke rolebinding & unset flag
- [ ] postmortem if >5 failing PRs

toni: who owns postmortem? if we have >5 failures, security leads (kevin + li) should own a short blameless writeup and remediation action items.
kevin: agreed. Add a follow-up: update the SAST runner to surface keystore failure codes distinctly so triage is faster. ticket: SEC-9812.
sam: small ask — can we add a `sast:keystore_failure` tag in the SAST job outputs so automation can route it to security-triage instead of general infra?
li: yep that's simple, will add a `metadata.failure_reason` JSON field.
marta: timeline: I'll start at 23:00, rolebinding at 23:05, run test at 23:10, revoke at 23:20. I'll ping here when each step completes.
kevin: thanks. one more thing — let's record the audithook retention change in the ticket. increase to 90 days for keystore ops logs for this event window.
marta: good call. filing now: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-9811 — includes checklist + evidence bucket path.
kevin: perfect. @oncall-bot please remind us at 23:18 to revoke bindings if not already revoked.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled for 23:18 UTC.
marta: starting rolebinding creation now.
marta: rolebinding created (ephemeral-scan-rr) — confirmed TTL 10m.
kevin: got the alert that test SAST started. watching the pipeline.
li: snapshotting logs now, pushing to /evidence/keystore-rotation-1765439999.zip
sam: SAST runner returned a single warning (keystore fetch slow) but did not fail. looks good.
kevin: excellent. leaving this thread open for 30m to watch for any delayed failures. thanks all for quick coordination. :rocket:
